newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Carnival's Fat King unleashes Rio celebrations.
newsitem.headline: Carnival's Fat King unleashes Rio celebrations.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro's annual carnival extravaganza got a sunny start on Friday as this year's "Rei Momo" or Fat King of carnival assumed his reign over the festival in a parade through the city centre.

The crowds cheered on as the mayor of Rio handed this year's Fat King a symbolic key to the city to unleash Rio's four-day revelry. The king is Alex de Oliveira Silva, 25, who weighs almost 500 pounds (225 kg).
"I herewith decree a state of carnival until Ash Wednesday," said the shiny-clad Rei Momo as he looked down from his bandwagon holding onto his oversized crown.
The king arrived in style with his blonde, blue-eyed carnival queen and two princesses.

His entourage of stilt-walking, fire-eating acrobats, drummers and samba dancers in sequin g-strings and glittering feather headresses gave a glimpse of what awaited carnival fans at the 70,000-capacity sambadrome stadium.

Here the samba school parades for which Rio's carnival is famous began on Friday night with the lowest grade of the second tier schools strutting their stuff in the hope of climbing the ranks of the samba school hierarchy.

But the smaller, cash-strapped groups, often from the city's poorest slums, failed to attract the multitudes which are certain to pack the sambadrome on Sunday and Monday nights when the royalty of samba makes its grand entrance.
Every year the Rio carnival builds up over the weekend to explode in a blaze of colours and glamour when the "special group" of schools takes the stage with ornate floats and extravagant costumes.
Numbering up to several thousand dancers, they compete with million-dollar budgets to become carnival champions.
